Aligns Thales with a major smart meter vendor, boosting IoT eSIM adoption potential.
Standards-based remote provisioning can speed deployments and switching across networks.
Expands addressable installed base without hardware swaps, aiding upgrades.
Centralized control could reduce opex and churn, improving stickiness.
Installed smart meters expected to rise to 180.9M by 2030, expanding TAM.

This is an early-to-mid stage strategy move to embed Thales’ eSIM in large utility IoT fleets. For a larger catalyst, watch for disclosed contract wins, deployment volumes, or revenue contribution tied to Landis+Gyr platforms.
